# UCI Online Retail II

Authoritative source record for the retail transaction data used by historical customer-lifetime-value and segmentation notebooks in `Medium-Blog`.

## Authoritative source

- Publisher: UCI Machine Learning Repository
- Dataset: Online Retail II
- DOI: `10.24432/C5CG6D`
- Licence: CC BY 4.0
- Canonical landing page: https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/502/online+retail+ii

UCI distributes the dataset as `online_retail_II.xlsx`. The CSV files in `Medium-Blog` are article-specific sheet extracts/copies and remain with those notebooks rather than being treated as independent canonical datasets.
